1186:
** δένδρεον**,
**δένδρον**, and **δένδρος**, τό (late δένδρος, ὁ, {{Refs 8th c.BC+|1st c.AD: Athenaeus Medicus cited in 4th c.AD: Oribasius Medicus (?) 7.4), δένδρεον always in _Epic dialect_ (δενδρέῳ, δενδρέων, _disyllable_, 8th c.BC: Ilias Homerus Epicus “Illiad” 3.152, 8th c.BC: Odyssea Homerus Epicus “Odyssey” 19.520)}}, also _Ionic dialect_, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 4.22}}, and _Doric dialect_, {{Refs 3rd c.BC+|“IG” 4.951.90 (Epid., 3rd c.BC)}}; _Aeolic dialect_ **δένδριον** {{Refs 3rd c.BC+|3rd c.BC: Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus 29.12}}; later _Epic dialect_ **δένδρειον**, τό, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|4th-3rd c.BC: Aratus Epicus 1008, 2nd c.BC: Nicander Epicus “Theriaca” 832: δένδρος, τό, _nominative_, “IG” 14.1934i3; _accusative_, 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 6.79}}; _genitive_ δένδρεος {{Refs 4th c.BC+|“IG” 4.951.91, δένδρους 4th c.BC: Meno Medicus “Iatrika” 32.53}}; _dative_ δένδρει, _Ionic dialect_ **-εϊ**{{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “περὶ φύσιος παιδίου” 26, 4th c.BC: Meno Medicus “Iatrika” 33.4, 2nd c.AD: Arrianus Historicus “Indica” 7.11: _nominative_ _plural_ δένδρη 5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Fragmenta” 484.5, 5th c.BC: Pherecrates Comicus 130.9, “IG” 4.951.121, “PHal.” 1.99 (3rd c.BC), 2nd c.AD(?): Antoninus Liberalis Mythographus 31.5; _dative_ _plural_ δένδρεσι 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 2.138, 5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “περὶ φύσιος παιδίου” 26}} (and so usually in _Attic dialect_ Prose. as {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 2.75, 5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Leges” 625b, compare 2nd c.AD: Moeris Grammaticus 131, and later, as “BCH” 12.27 (from Mylasa), 1st c.BC-1st c.AD: Strabo Geographus 2.1.14), late δενδράσι variant in 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Bellum Judaicum” 6.1.1: indeterminate forms, _nominative_ _plural_ δένδρεα 4th-5th c.BC: Hecataeus Milesius Historicus 292 (a) 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus, 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 1.17, +others, 5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Bacchae” 563 (Lyric poetry); _genitive_ δενδρέων 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 1.202, +others, “Tab.Heracl.” 1.129, +others: δέδρον, τό, first in 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 1.193, 3.107}}, regular in _Attic dialect_, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Lysias Orator 7.28, etc.}}, and later Gr. (except in _dative_ _plural_, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|see above), compare 2nd c.AD: Aelius Dionysius Grammaticus “fragment” 119}}:— **tree**: δένδρον ἐλάας an olive-**tree,** {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Aristophanes Comicus “Aves” 617}}; δ. ἄρκτου, ={ἀκτῆ}, Ps.-{{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st c.AD: Dioscorides (Dioscurides) Medicus 4.173}}; δένδρα **fruit-** or **mast-bearing trees,** opposed to ὕλη, timber, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 4.69; δ. ἥμερα καὶ ἄγρια 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 8.115}}; δένδρα **tall plants,** {{NT+4th c.BC+|[prev. author] 1.193 (so of rattan, 4th-3rd c.BC: Theophrastus Philosophus “Historia Plantarum” 5.4.7; mustard, NT.Matt.13.32)}}; αὖον δ. **stick,** {{Refs 3rd c.BC+|3rd c.BC: Callimachus Epicus “Fragmenta” 49.}}
